title: Multi-View Causal Discovery without Non-Gaussianity: Identifiability and Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2502.20115v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal discovery is a difficult problem that typically relies on strong assumptions on the data-generating model, such as non-Gaussianity. In practice, many modern applications provide multiple related views of the same system, which has rarely been considered for causal discovery. Here, we leverage this multi-view structure to achieve causal discovery with weak assumptions. We propose a multi-view linear Structural Equation Model (SEM) that extends the well-known framework of non-Gaussian disturbances by alternatively leveraging correlation over views. We prove the identifiability of the model for acyclic SEMs. Subsequently, we propose several multi-view causal discovery algorithms, inspired by single-view algorithms (DirectLiNGAM, PairwiseLiNGAM, and ICA-LiNGAM). The new methods are validated through simulations and applications on neuroimaging data, where they enable the estimation of causal graphs between brain regions.

translated_title: 无需非高斯性假设的多视图因果发现：可辨识性与算法
translated_abstract: 因果发现是一个困难的问题，通常依赖于对数据生成模型的强假设，例如非高斯性。在实践中，许多现代应用提供了同一系统的多个相关视图，而这一点在因果发现领域很少被考虑。在此，我们利用这种多视图结构，在弱假设条件下实现因果发现。我们提出了一个多视图线性结构方程模型（SEM），该模型通过交替利用视图间的相关性，扩展了著名的非高斯扰动框架。我们证明了该模型在无环SEM情形下的可辨识性。随后，受单视图算法（DirectLiNGAM、PairwiseLiNGAM和ICA-LiNGAM）的启发，我们提出了几种多视图因果发现算法。新方法通过仿真实验和神经影像数据应用得到了验证，在这些应用中，它们能够估计脑区之间的因果图。
tldr: 本文提出一种多视图线性结构方程模型及相应算法，通过利用同一系统多个视图间的相关性，在不依赖非高斯性假设的情况下实现了因果发现的可辨识性，并成功应用于脑区间因果图的估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-view linear structural equation model and corresponding algorithms that leverage correlations across multiple views of the same system, achieving identifiable causal discovery without relying on non-Gaussianity assumptions, with successful applications to estimating causal graphs between brain regions.
